toml:
# Nadir imager radiometry and image quality for an ILLUSTRATIVE small Earth-observation camera
# (no operator's design): 0.40 m aperture, 3.6 m focal length (F/9), 5.5 um pixels, from
# 500 km. The run gives the signal-to-noise budget of a 15 % reflectance scene, the system MTF
# at Nyquist, the relative edge response and the GIQE version 4 NIIRS. MODELLED: the NIIRS is
# an empirical regression evaluated on modelled inputs, not a rated image.
kind = "eo-radiometry"
altitude_m = 500000.0
focal_length_m = 3.6
aperture_m = 0.40
pixel_pitch_um = 5.5
wavelength_um = 0.65
bandwidth_um = 0.2
fill_factor = 1.0
smear_px = 0.2
jitter_px_rms = 0.1
reflectance = 0.15
solar_irradiance_w_m2_um = 1550.0
sun_zenith_deg = 40.0
atmospheric_transmittance = 0.7
path_radiance_w_m2_sr_um = 0.0
optics_transmittance = 0.8
integration_s = 0.0005
quantum_efficiency = 0.6
dark_current_e_s = 50.0
read_noise_e = 20.0
full_well_e = 30000.0
adc_bits = 12
summary: eo-radiometry: GSD 0.76 m, Q 1.06, SNR 39 (well 6 %), MTF@Nyquist 0.212, RER 0.573, GIQE4 NIIRS 4.27 (MODELLED)
